Wait for the cert generator job first: kubectl get job spiffe-cert-generator -n dojo-sec-spiffe (needs COMPLETIONS: 1/1 before the secret exists)
The SPIFFE ID is stored directly in the secret — read it: kubectl get secret workload-svid -n dojo-sec-spiffe -o jsonpath='{.data.spiffe-id}' | base64 -d
The flag is at the end of the SPIFFE ID path (after /sa/). The service account name uses KUBE_ prefix — convert to flag format: KUBE_something → KUBE{something}
